units.source_text: 原来这二辆车子是伊势斋宫的母夫人六条妃子的，她大约因为心情不快，故而悄悄地出门游览一下。

en.t: It turned out that these two carriages belonged to Lady Rokujo, the mother of the Ise Vestal Princess; probably feeling out of spirits, she had quietly gone out for a little excursion.

units.source_text: 她想保守秘密，然而葵夫人的侍从们自然能够识破。

en.t: She meant to keep it secret, but Lady Aoi's attendants were naturally able to see through her disguise.

units.source_text: 他们便对六条妃子的侍从们骂道：“你们是什么来头，口气这么强硬？

en.t: They then shouted abuse at Lady Rokujo's attendants, saying, "Who do you think you are, speaking so arrogantly?

units.source_text: 也算是仗源氏大将的势力么？”

en.t: Do you imagine you can rely on the power of General Genji?"

units.source_text: 葵夫人的侍从中有几个是源氏大将的家人，他们觉得对不起六条妃子，然而也不便照顾她，因此假装不知。

en.t: Among Lady Aoi's attendants were several members of General Genji's household; they felt sorry toward Lady Rokujo, but since they could not very well look after her, they pretended not to notice.

units.source_text: 争吵的结果，葵夫人的车子终于赶了过来，六条妃子的车子被挤在葵夫人的侍女车后面，望出去什么也看不见。

en.t: As a result of the quarrel, Lady Aoi's carriage finally pushed its way forward, while Lady Rokujo's carriage was crowded behind the carriages of Lady Aoi's waiting women, so that nothing could be seen from it.

units.source_text: 六条妃子觉得看不见还在其次，她的微行被人认出，被人辱骂又赶走，实在无限痛心！

en.t: For Lady Rokujo, not being able to see was secondary; that her secret outing had been recognized, that she had been insulted and driven away, caused her immeasurable pain.
